primary_name: Liu Xiang, claim about Sun Wu's victory over Chu

names.name: Liu Xiang, claim about Sun Wu's victory over Chu

summary: A later Han writer's claim that Sun Wu beat 200,000 Chu troops with 30,000 because the enemy was undisciplined.
bias_notes: Late and rhetorical; the numbers are flagged inflated (CLM-000068).
reliability_notes: Known only as quoted by Giles (SRC-000031); the work is not named in the pilot doc.
